chronicle.tiered_pricing: Drought: the water system imposed tiered pricing and subsidy cuts. The target was met; about one smallholder farm in five failed.
chronicle.baseline_and_petition: Drought: the water system protected a baseline for every household, cut the largest users hardest with a levy funding smallholder compensation, and asked the authority for a three-season deadline.
chronicle.relocate_smallholders: Drought: the water system used emergency powers to buy out and relocate the smallholder families. The community dispersed; the aquifer recovered.
chronicle.defer_and_pump: Drought: the water system made no cuts and drew down the aquifer. The aquifer lost about a third of its capacity for good.
